review.summary: The diff opts the text chat path out of storage by adding `httpOptions: { extraBody: { store: false } }` to the `generateContent` config in app/api/chat/route.ts. That is a plausible approach, but it has not been shown to work. The only new check is a regex the agent wrote, and it passes whenever the string is present. Nothing shows the SDK serialises `store` where the API expects it, or that the API accepts it. The Live call sites the match agent named (authTokens.create, live.connect) are left unchanged with no stated reason. The 'verified' grade overstates what the checks prove.

concerns.issue: Line ~37: `extraBody` merges `store: false` into the raw request body. I could not confirm from the quoted changelog that `store` is a top-level field of the generateContent request body rather than nested elsewhere. If it is placed wrongly or not recognised, the API may silently ignore it, so requests would still be stored. It could also reject it with a 400, which would break every chat request because the catch returns 500. Confirm the field location in the Generate Content API reference and check how @google/genai's HttpOptions.extraBody is merged for models.generateContent.

The check only greps the source for `extraBody: { store: false }`. It proves the text exists, not that it reaches the wire or has any effect. No request is captured, mocked or sent live. The 'verified' grade rests on this check, so it should be needs-review.

`live.connect` (line ~203) was named as affected but is not changed. The changelog wording covers the Generate Content API. Whether the Live API sessions also default to storage is not addressed. If it does, voice transcripts of order-DB queries may be stored with no opt-out.
`authTokens.create` (line ~25) is untouched, and the PR gives no reason. If storage for Live sessions is governed by the ephemeral token's constraints, the opt-out would need to go there.

The field is sent unconditionally, including for free-tier or older projects where storage was never the default. Confirm the API accepts `store` on all tiers and the pinned API version (the default v1beta here), rather than erroring.

checkFirst: Confirm in the Gemini API reference that `store` is a top-level generateContent request field, and that it is accepted on the API version the SDK uses by default.
Check that @google/genai's HttpOptions.extraBody is applied to the models.generateContent request body in the installed SDK version. Ideally capture one outgoing request to see it.
Decide whether Live API sessions (live.connect via ephemeral tokens) also store by default, and whether they need an opt-out.
Downgrade the grade to needs-review unless a live or mocked request test confirms `store: false` is sent and accepted.

tasks.reasoning: The repo uses the Gemini Live API (live.connect with ephemeral auth tokens). authTokens.create config may pin the live model in its constraints and would need the same model update.
